name: Pacman packages
description: Installs a list of system packages with pacman from the repositories the Arch Linux image already configures, as part of a full system upgrade.

packages.description: Comma-separated packages to install: a name, a provided name, or a group, optionally with a version constraint (name>=version). Whitespace around entries and empty entries are ignored; an empty list installs nothing, and a non-empty list also upgrades the whole system.
